name: develop
description: Deliver repository changes, upgrade dependencies, audit Codex compatibility, review work, clean up, and improve workflows.

interface.longDescription: Eight skills for repository changes, dependency upgrades, thread-scoped cleanup, independent review, and workflow improvement. Explicit-only deep-clean inspects user-expanded machine scope; upgrade-codex audits Codex compatibility. A native Codex context guard denies known oversized whole-file reads and offers opt-in verified result preservation; otherwise oversized results warn and pass through. No external workflow plugin required.
defaultPrompt: develop iterate: fix this repository’s failing build.
develop upgrade: assess and upgrade this repository’s dependencies.
develop kaizen: review these selected sessions and recommend workflow improvements.
